Name: Simri, Son of Hosah
Summary: Son of Hosah of Merari, made chief by his father though not the firstborn.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:10: Son of Hosah of Merari, made chief by his father though not the firstborn.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Simri stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
